game.title: Princess Peach: Showtime!
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Switch exclusive, no native achievement list exists on any platform. Several disputed dossier facts were deliberately excluded or left unquantified to avoid Rule 1/2 violations: the post-game Hidden Theets hunt has no confirmed in-game counter and its total is contradictory across sources (70 vs. an internal ~46 vs. a separate ~16), so only a single 'find your first Theet' trophy exists rather than a 'collect all' trophy. Sparkle Gem-threshold-to-unlock-boss numbers are contradictory across sources and are never cited. Outfit/Collection totals (72 vs. an inconsistent 84-item breakdown from the same source) are disputed, so the Wardrobe Icon trophy points at the Collection menu's fully-filled state rather than citing a specific outfit count. No confirmed aggregate '% complete' stat exists anywhere in the game, so full-completion trophies (Gem Completionist, Backstage Pass, Picture Perfect, Wardrobe Icon) are verified via each relevant per-category screen showing no gaps remaining, not a single percentage stat.

trophies.name: Curtain Up
trophies.description: Complete your first play in Sparkle Theater by clearing any Act One stage.
trophies.verification: The stage is marked cleared on the Theater floor map.

trophies.name: Take a Bow, Disco Wing
trophies.description: Defeat Disco Wing, the Darkle boss guarding 1F.
trophies.verification: Disco Wing is marked defeated on the 1F floor map.

trophies.name: Fangs for Nothing
trophies.description: Defeat Light Fang, the Darkle boss guarding 2F.
trophies.verification: Light Fang is marked defeated on the 2F floor map.

trophies.name: Every Stage, Every Role
trophies.description: Complete the Act One stage of all ten Peach-formations, experiencing every genre the theater has to offer.
trophies.verification: The Theater floor map shows every formation's first act cleared.

trophies.name: Claws for Applause
trophies.description: Defeat Purrjector Cat, the Darkle boss guarding 3F.
trophies.verification: Purrjector Cat is marked defeated on the 3F floor map.

trophies.name: Steal the Spotlight
trophies.description: Defeat Spotlion, the Darkle boss guarding 4F.
trophies.verification: Spotlion is marked defeated on the 4F floor map.

trophies.name: Rescue Every Sparkla
trophies.description: Complete the Basement 'Dark' finale stage for every Peach-formation, rescuing all ten Sparklas and unlocking the theater's final confrontation.
trophies.verification: The Basement floor map shows every Dark stage cleared, and the path to the final stage opens.

trophies.name: The Final Bow
trophies.description: Defeat the theater's final threat and save Sparkle Theater's grand show.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene plays and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Gem Hunter
trophies.description: Collect every Sparkle Gem within a single play.
trophies.verification: The play's results screen shows a full gem count for that level.

trophies.name: Gem Completionist
trophies.description: Collect every Sparkle Gem in every main story play.
trophies.verification: Every main story level shows a full gem count when re-selected from the Theater Lobby.

trophies.name: Ribboner's Welcome
trophies.description: Obtain your first Ribbon from a Ribboner.
trophies.verification: The awarded dress or ribbon design appears in the Collection menu immediately after obtaining it.

trophies.name: Backstage Pass
trophies.description: Obtain every Ribbon offered by a Ribboner across every main story play.
trophies.verification: Every level shows its Ribbon obtained when re-selected from the Theater Lobby, and every ribbon-unlocked design appears in the Collection menu.

trophies.name: Say Cheese
trophies.description: Earn your first Album Photo by collecting every gem in a play and visiting the Pictioneer.
trophies.verification: The photo appears filled in the Photo Album section of the Collection menu.

trophies.name: Picture Perfect
trophies.description: Complete the Photo Album with every photo, including the post-game bonus shots earned from boss rematches.
trophies.verification: The Photo Album section of the Collection menu shows no empty slots remaining.

trophies.name: Star Performer
trophies.description: Earn a Gold medal in any single Action Rehearsal.
trophies.verification: The Gold medal and its exclusive dress reward appear on that Rehearsal's results screen.

trophies.name: Take Five
trophies.description: Earn a Gold medal in all five Action Rehearsals, unlocking every exclusive Rehearsal dress.
trophies.verification: Each Rehearsal's results screen shows a Gold medal, and all five exclusive dresses appear in the Collection menu.

trophies.name: Wardrobe Icon
trophies.description: Fill the Collection menu with every unlockable outfit for Peach and Stella.
trophies.verification: The outfit section of the Collection menu shows no empty slots remaining.

trophies.name: Strike a Pose
trophies.description: Trigger a Hidden Pose Spotlight for the first time by striking a pose during a play.
trophies.verification: The spotlight effect triggers and its reward is granted on the spot.

trophies.name: Ninja in Training
trophies.description: Find your first hidden Theet during the post-game hide-and-seek challenge unlocked by talking to the Ninja Sparkla.
trophies.verification: The found Theet is acknowledged in-game and counted toward the Ninja Sparkla's challenge.

trophies.name: Curtain Call Decor
trophies.description: Purchase a decoration for the Sparkle Theater lobby using leftover Sparkle Gems.
trophies.verification: The purchased decoration appears placed in the theater lobby.

trophies.name: Grand Finale Rematch
trophies.description: Complete all three optional challenges for every one of the five post-game boss rematches.
trophies.verification: After the credits, boss rematch portraits appear on each floor. Each boss's portrait shows all three challenges completed, and their associated Sparkle Gems and Album Photo have been awarded.

trophies.name: Standing Ovation
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.
